variableDescription: mailboxId is the numeric mailbox ID. verificationToken proves ownership for that mailbox. dkimSelector and dkimValue come from the server-side Postmark Domains API. All requests are signed; users cannot choose arbitrary record hosts or targets.
serviceName: Connect a dedicated support email domain
description: Configures Postmark sending authentication and per-mailbox domain ownership. Also routes incoming mail for the selected dedicated domain to Postmark. The app refuses existing non-Postmark MX records.
